The notification date does not by itself establish a different start. The ordinary late-notification paragraph points to exceptions, and A4361 covers another relevant benefit, its cessation or a change in its rate. [A4-34] [A4-36] [A4-37]

F1123 describes highest-rate care, not highest-rate mobility, as one qualifying route for the higher disabled-child addition. Other routes are present in the source. [F1-17] [F1-18]

The exact assessment-period boundaries are unknown, as is the award history. A4361's examples concern the carer element. They do not establish a disabled-child determination. Historical statutory applicability and independent specialist review remain unestablished. The rates table does not establish the amount applicable in January 2025. Do not calculate arrears.
